scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @tastematcher/common lint && pnpm --filter @tastematcher/webapi lint && pnpm --filter @tastematcher/functions lint && pnpm --filter @tastematcher/frontend lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @tastematcher/common typecheck && pnpm --filter @tastematcher/webapi typecheck && pnpm --filter @tastematcher/functions typecheck && pnpm --filter @tastematcher/frontend typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm run test:common && pnpm run test:webapi && pnpm run test:functions && pnpm run test:frontend
scripts.quality:fast: pnpm run build:common && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.ci:check: pnpm run quality:fast && pnpm run build:common && pnpm run build:webapi && pnpm run build:functions && pnpm run build:frontend && pnpm run validate:static
scripts.start:local:production: pnpm run sync:local:production && pnpm run build:common && pnpm --parallel --filter @tastematcher/webapi --filter @tastematcher/frontend run start:local:production
